newsitem.title: USA: Kmart adds Publishers Clearing CEO to board.
newsitem.headline: Kmart adds Publishers Clearing CEO to board.

text.p: Kmart Corp said Tuesday Robin Smith, chairman and chief executive of Publishers Clearing House, will join its board, effective November 19.

The addition of Smith brings the number of members on the retailer's board to 14 from 13, the company said. Kmart recently has named eight new directors, including Floyd Hall who became chairman of the company in June 1995.

"During her tenure as chief executive, Robin Smith has led the substantial growth and diversification of Publishers Clearing House, the world's largest magazine subscription company," Hall said in a statement.
Kmart added that Smith brings extensive retail, marketing and promotional experience to the board.
